artifacts.title: Federal Grants and RFP Fit Brief
artifacts.description: A source-cited brief for builders matching public grants and procurement notices to a specific project profile.

rights.attribution: SAM.gov, Grants.gov, and Data.gov source links required

sample_questions: Which opportunities match a rural AI workforce project?
What documents are required before bid/no-bid?

content.summary: Use public federal opportunity sources to produce a fit-scored opportunity brief with deadlines, eligibility flags, required documents, amendment watch items, and next actions.
workflow: Collect opportunity notices from authorized public APIs or cached official exports.
Normalize deadline, agency, NAICS/CFDA/assistance listing, place of performance, and eligibility fields.
Score fit against the buyer profile and surface disqualifiers before recommending effort.
Return source links, last-checked timestamps, and a checklist for the next human action.
next_actions: Build a profile schema for organization type, location, capabilities, and target award size.
Seed daily SAM.gov and Grants.gov snapshots before adding partner-only sources.
Export accepted matches to Sheets, Airtable, or a proposal tracker.

artifacts.title: Regulatory Deadline Watch
artifacts.description: A deadline/change radar for builders tracking public regulatory notices and compliance windows.

rights.attribution: Regulations.gov and agency source links required

sample_questions: Which AI or data rules changed this week?
What deadlines affect a small healthcare software business?

content.summary: Track public regulatory notices, normalize docket metadata, and generate non-legal action checklists for builders who need to notice changes early.
workflow: Read official docket and notice metadata through permitted public APIs or exports.
Extract comment windows, effective dates, affected industries, and cited statutes.
Diff the latest snapshot against prior cached versions and flag changed deadlines.
Return a source-cited monitor page with practical next-check prompts.
next_actions: Add saved industry profiles for AI, construction, healthcare, fintech, and food businesses.
Attach non-legal disclaimers to every compliance artifact.
Create alert routes for deadline changes and new comment windows.

artifacts.title: Local Market and Program Map
artifacts.description: A regional builder brief that combines public datasets, grant catalogs, and Census business patterns into a local opportunity map.

rights.attribution: Data.gov, Census, and Grants.gov source links required

sample_questions: Where are local programs for climate or public safety builders?
What business-density context should a founder know before entering a region?

content.summary: Combine official public catalogs and aggregate Census business data into a regional opportunity map that is useful to new builders without exposing private records.
workflow: Normalize public program records and aggregate local business signals by geography and industry.
Preserve source URLs, retrieval dates, geography scope, and data vintage.
Score local relevance with clear caveats for annual or stale datasets.
Export a map-ready table plus a plain-English opportunity brief.
next_actions: Add region profile inputs for county, state, industry, and buyer type.
Build a source-vintage warning when annual Census records are mixed with daily program data.
Create example pages for Colorado public safety, Houston SMB, and wildfire resilience.

artifacts.title: Developer API Change Radar
artifacts.description: A tested-docs radar for builders tracking public API docs, changelogs, pricing pages, limits, and auth scope changes.

rights.attribution: Vendor documentation and repository links required

sample_questions: Which API limits changed since the last agent run?
Which examples are stale or untested?

content.summary: Track public docs and releases as a builder-facing wiki that separates current facts, tested examples, stale snippets, and unknown contract areas.
workflow: Ingest public docs and release metadata only where source terms permit indexing.
Diff endpoint names, auth scopes, SDK versions, pricing limits, and breaking-change notes.
Mark snippets as tested, untested, stale, or blocked by auth.
Return a source-cited change radar for agents before they generate code.
next_actions: Seed first sources from Sapphire's own API docs, x402 docs, MCP docs, and partner-friendly open docs.
Add a small endpoint-test harness for public no-auth examples.
Expose an MCP prompt for purchase planning before a paid docs fetch.
